panels.description: Canonical instruments registered for the selected market.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM marketcow_production.instrument_master WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR market = '$market')

panels.title: Registered instruments

panels.description: Distinct symbols with a current quote in the selected market.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(symbol) AS value FROM market_quote_latest FINAL WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'market') = '$market')

panels.title: Symbols with quotes

panels.description: Distinct symbols with canonical historical bars.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(symbol) AS value FROM market_bar_canonical FINAL WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR market = '$market')

panels.title: Symbols with bars

panels.description: Age of the latest MarketCow ingestion, not the market event.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, 0, dateDiff('second', max(ingested_at), now())) AS value FROM market_quote_latest FINAL WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'market') = '$market')

panels.title: Collection age

panels.description: Age of the newest exchange/provider event. Non-trading sessions can be old while ingestion stays fresh.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(count() = 0, 0, dateDiff('second', max(observed_at), now())) AS value FROM market_quote_latest FINAL WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'market') = '$market')

panels.title: Market-event age

panels.description: Mechanical continuity exceptions for the selected scope; exchange calendars are not inferred.

targets.rawSql: WITH ordered AS (SELECT symbol, interval, adjustment, bar_time, lagInFrame(bar_time) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol, interval, adjustment ORDER BY bar_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS previous_bar FROM market_bar_canonical FINAL WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR market = '$market') AND ('$interval' = 'All' OR interval = '$interval') AND ('$symbol' = 'All' OR symbol = '$symbol')), measured AS (SELECT dateDiff('second', previous_bar, bar_time) AS gap_seconds, multiIf(interval = '1m',60,interval = '5m',300,interval = '15m',900,interval = '30m',1800,interval IN ('60m','1h'),3600,interval = '1d',86400,0) AS expected_seconds, interval, previous_bar FROM ordered) SELECT countIf(previous_bar IS NOT NULL AND expected_seconds > 0 AND gap_seconds > if(interval = '1d', expected_seconds * 4.0, expected_seconds * 1.5)) AS value FROM measured

panels.title: Unexpected gaps

targets.rawSql: SELECT market, count(*) AS instruments FROM marketcow_production.instrument_master GROUP BY market ORDER BY instruments DESC

panels.description: Coverage is shown per market rather than as a single database-wide row count.

targets.rawSql: WITH coverage AS (SELECT market, symbol, 'bar' AS layer, ingested_at, observed_at FROM market_bar_canonical FINAL UNION ALL SELECT JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'market') AS market, symbol, 'quote' AS layer, ingested_at, observed_at FROM market_quote_latest FINAL) SELECT market, uniqExactIf(symbol, layer = 'quote') AS quote_symbols, uniqExactIf(symbol, layer = 'bar') AS bar_symbols, maxIf(observed_at, layer = 'quote') AS newest_market_event, max(ingested_at) AS newest_ingestion FROM coverage WHERE market != '' GROUP BY market ORDER BY quote_symbols DESC, bar_symbols DESC

panels.title: Tradable data coverage by market

panels.description: Separates exchange event time from ingestion time and exposes session, source and tradability.

targets.rawSql: SELECT symbol, JSONExtractFloat(payload_json, 'price') AS price, JSONExtractFloat(payload_json, 'change_pct') AS change_pct, JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'currency') AS currency, JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'session') AS session, JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'source') AS source, JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'quality_status') AS quality_status, JSONExtractBool(payload_json, 'tradable') AS tradable, observed_at AS market_event_at, ingested_at, dateDiff('second', observed_at, now()) AS event_age_seconds, dateDiff('second', ingested_at, now()) AS ingestion_age_seconds FROM market_quote_latest FINAL WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'market') = '$market') AND ('$symbol' = 'All' OR symbol = '$symbol') ORDER BY symbol LIMIT 500

panels.title: Latest quotes — selected market

panels.description: Canonical time-series coverage for each selected symbol and interval.

targets.rawSql: SELECT symbol, any(market) AS market_name, interval, adjustment, count() AS canonical_rows, min(bar_time) AS first_bar, max(bar_time) AS last_bar, max(ingested_at) AS last_ingested, uniqExact(selected_source) AS source_count FROM market_bar_canonical FINAL WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR market = '$market') AND ('$interval' = 'All' OR interval = '$interval') AND ('$symbol' = 'All' OR symbol = '$symbol') GROUP BY symbol, interval, adjustment ORDER BY symbol, interval LIMIT 1000

panels.title: Historical coverage — selected market

panels.description: Historical depth by interval for the selected scope.

targets.rawSql: SELECT interval, count() AS rows FROM market_bar_canonical FINAL WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR market = '$market') AND ('$interval' = 'All' OR interval = '$interval') AND ('$symbol' = 'All' OR symbol = '$symbol') GROUP BY interval ORDER BY rows DESC

panels.title: Rows by interval

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, uniqExact(symbol) AS symbols FROM market_quote_latest FINAL WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'market') = '$market') AND ('$symbol' = 'All' OR symbol = '$symbol') GROUP BY source ORDER BY symbols DESC

panels.description: Quality labels across current quotes and canonical bars.

targets.rawSql: SELECT quality_status, count() AS records FROM (SELECT JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'quality_status') AS quality_status FROM market_quote_latest FINAL WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR JSONExtractString(payload_json, 'market') = '$market') AND ('$symbol' = 'All' OR symbol = '$symbol') UNION ALL SELECT quality_status FROM market_bar_canonical FINAL WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR market = '$market') AND ('$symbol' = 'All' OR symbol = '$symbol')) WHERE quality_status != '' GROUP BY quality_status ORDER BY records DESC

panels.title: Quality status

panels.description: Recent ingestion activity for the selected scope.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(ingested_at) AS time, source, count() AS rows FROM market_bar_raw FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(ingested_at) AND ('$market' = 'All' OR market = '$market') AND ('$interval' = 'All' OR interval = '$interval') AND ('$symbol' = 'All' OR symbol = '$symbol') GROUP BY time, source ORDER BY time

panels.title: Raw ingestion activity

panels.description: Fail-visible continuity exceptions. Daily gaps tolerate weekends but are not exchange-calendar aware.

targets.rawSql: WITH ordered AS (SELECT symbol, market, interval, bar_time, lagInFrame(bar_time) OVER (PARTITION BY symbol, interval, adjustment ORDER BY bar_time ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS previous_bar FROM market_bar_canonical FINAL WHERE ('$market' = 'All' OR market = '$market') AND ('$interval' = 'All' OR interval = '$interval') AND ('$symbol' = 'All' OR symbol = '$symbol')), measured AS (SELECT *, dateDiff('second', previous_bar, bar_time) AS gap_seconds, multiIf(interval = '1m',60,interval = '5m',300,interval = '15m',900,interval = '30m',1800,interval IN ('60m','1h'),3600,interval = '1d',86400,0) AS expected_seconds FROM ordered) SELECT symbol, any(market) AS market, interval, countIf(previous_bar IS NOT NULL AND expected_seconds > 0 AND gap_seconds > if(interval = '1d', expected_seconds * 4.0, expected_seconds * 1.5)) AS unexpected_gaps, maxIf(gap_seconds, previous_bar IS NOT NULL) AS max_gap_seconds FROM measured GROUP BY symbol, interval HAVING unexpected_gaps > 0 ORDER BY unexpected_gaps DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Continuity exceptions

panels.description: Global storage operations; intentionally not affected by the market selector.

targets.rawSql: SELECT database, table, formatReadableSize(sum(bytes_on_disk)) AS disk, sum(rows) AS physical_rows, count() AS active_parts FROM system.parts WHERE active AND database = currentDatabase() GROUP BY database, table ORDER BY sum(bytes_on_disk) DESC

panels.title: Operational storage (global)

panels.description: Global immutable raw-evidence inventory; intentionally not a trading coverage metric.

targets.rawSql: SELECT dataset, source, count(*) AS artifacts, sum(byte_size) AS bytes, min(ingested_at) AS first_ingested, max(ingested_at) AS last_ingested FROM marketcow_production.raw_artifact_manifest GROUP BY dataset, source ORDER BY artifacts DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Raw artifact inventory (global)
